# simplemdm_assignmentgroup_app_binding (Resource)

Binds an existing SimpleMDM app to an existing assignment group with optional deployment_type and install_type overrides. Useful for managing memberships of UI-owned assignment groups (including dynamic groups) without taking ownership of the assignment group itself.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) Identifier of the app to bind to the assignment group.
- `assignment_group_id` (String) Identifier of the assignment group that should receive the app.

### Optional

- `deployment_type` (String) Deployment type override sent on assignment. Must be one of "standard" or "munki". Mirrors the `apps_deployment_types` map on simplemdm_assignmentgroup. Changing the value re-issues the assign call against SimpleMDM (no resource replacement needed).
- `install_type` (String) Install type override sent on assignment. Must be one of "managed", "self_serve", "default_installs", or "managed_updates". Only meaningful when deployment_type == "munki". Mirrors the `apps_install_types` map on simplemdm_assignmentgroup.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier in the form "<assignment_group_id>:<app_id>".
